{{Quote|Nae Nuuv, former Padawan to Master Kaedan.|Nae Nuuv|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
'''Nae Nuuv''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When the subsequent [[Galactic War]] broke out between the two powers, Nuuv underwent the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], and his first assignment as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in [[3640 BBY]] was to aid the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in the ongoing [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I finished my trials right before coming to this star-forsaken planet. I've been fighting for my life ever since.|Nae Nuuv|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
[[File:Rusty_Freighter.png|thumb|right|200px|Nae Nuuv sought refuge in the Rusty Freighter cantina.]]
Nae Nuuv was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> who was found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaric Kaedan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> during the subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the Empire, Nuuv underwent the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and became a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;and was promptly sent to the embattled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where he aided other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in the ongoing [[Battle of Corellia]]. Nuuv was one of the few Jedi still alive on Corellia when the Order's [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]], [[Satele Shan]], dispatched Jedi reinforcements to the planet.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I've been running and fighting for days. All I wanted was a drink, but that's obviously too much to ask!|Nae Nuuv|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
Nae Nuuv was of the diminutive Sullustan [[Species/Legends|species]] and had large, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and gray-brown skin. A wise-cracking young Jedi, Nuuv had a fondness for [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] and was often easily excited or even angered, particularly after experiencing [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of battle on Corellia and succumbing to combat stress. Nuuv was troubled by the number of Jedi [[Death/Legends|deaths]] he witnessed on Corellia, leading him to question the Order's belief that the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] was stronger than the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Equipment==
Nuuv wore [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] that were brown with gray-green markings and patterns.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nae Nuuv first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] produced by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. Nuuv will only appear in the Jedi Knight mission "Jedi Commander" on Corellia if the player fails to redeem the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] during the Prologue, and Nuuv will then appear in Morr's place in the [[Rusty Freighter Cantina|Rusty Freighter]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] district. He will continue to appear in Morr's place in all subsequent cutscenes, though neither Nuuv nor Morr speak to the player after their initial meeting.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> As a Republic character, the Jedi Knight is assumed to only choose the moral light-side options,<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points.</ref> so this article assumes that the player successfully defeated Morr and allowed him to be rehabilitated by the Jedi Order, and thus never encountered Nuuv.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> While his ultimate fate is left unknown in the light-side scenario, Nuuv's comments about his [[Time/Legends|time]] on Corellia before the [[Hero of Tython]]'s arrival are still taken to be correct.<ref name="Light Side" />
